messages:
maya-sales: Heads up — ACME signed LOI and they need our SOC 2 report + a temporary attestation letter for their vendor risk team. They also asked if we can share redacted artifacts before NDA inked. Timeline: they want something by Friday EOD. Anyone handled this recently?

chris-se: We usually require an executed NDA before sending the full report. For POCs we can provide a redacted PDF + a short attestation (bridge) letter. I can assemble the attestation if legal ok with wording.

julian-sec: Agree re: NDA. We have the SOC 2 Type II covering 2024 for hosted API. Redacted copy is fine. Bridge-letter should call out: scope (Hosted API only), period covered, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS, access controls, monitoring/IR. I can draft security paragraph.

tara-legal: NDA is a hard requirement for full report. For bridge letters we have a template — signatory is typically our CISO or Legal Ops depending on content. I'll pre-approve a short attestation for non-sensitive items. Send me the customer name and exact scope.

maya-sales: Customer is AcmeCorp (vendor team contact: raj@acme). Scope requested: Hosted API (no private deployments). I'll send them our mutual NDA link now: https://redwood.example/nda (please treat as placeholder).

chris-se: To be clear — we can provide redacted SOC2 + bridge letter with expected SOC completion date noted. Draft wording I'd propose:

```
Scope: Redwood Hosted API (no customer-managed/private deployments)\nPeriod: Jan 1 2024 - Dec 31 2024\nControls: logical access, encryption at rest & in transit, KMS integrated key management, logging & retention, incident response & vulnerability management\nLimitations: redacted attachments; full report requires executed NDA
```

Is that OK?

julian-sec: That looks good. Add a sentence about least privilege and that transient PII is not stored beyond request lifecycle (unless customer chooses). Also add patch cadence and SOC auditor name if allowed.

tara-legal: Approved with one change — don't name the auditor in bridge letter without compliance review. I'll prepare the NDA email and the bridge-letter template. I can sign or route to CISO based on final wording.

maya-sales: Awesome. I pinged raj with NDA link and asked for counter-signed copy. ETA from them unknown. Tara — can you draft the bridge letter and loop chris & julian for technical lines? Prefer turn-around 24-48h once NDA inbound.

tara-legal: Yep will draft within 24h after I have customer name in the header. chris/julian — please DM me any technical snippets you want verbatim. :+1:

compliance-bot: Document uploaded to secure-share: https://secure.redwood.example/soc2/acme-redacted-1769443210.pdf (access gated behind NDA) :lock:

maya-sales: Thanks team. I'll update ACME and follow up on signature. Tagging @chris-se @julian-sec for any last-minute tech language.

chris-se: I'll prepare a one-paragraph technical blurb and drop it to Tara's DM within an hour.

julian-sec: Same — I'll include log retention numbers and KMS provider details (AWS KMS) in the DM.

maya-sales: Great — closing loop when NDA arrives. :handshake:
